name: Gaumont SA
summary: Gaumont SA, together with its subsidiaries, engages in production of all media in Central and Eastern Europe, Asia, North America, Latin America, Western Europe, and internationally. It operates in French Film Production and Distribution, Audiovisual Production and Distribution, and Real Estate Activity and Holding Businesses segments. The company produces and distributes feature films, audiovisual programs, television series, dramas, documentaries, and animated films and series. It sells broadcasting rights to television channels; distributes video and video on demand; and engages in the real estate management and coordination activities.
